element_preconditions.reason: All three report preconditions (operator creator allowance, backdated/ended startTimestamp, creator predeposited rewards) are captured as grounded Booleans with correct checkpoints and entity bindings; the qualitative time condition is stated without numeric definition, so a free Boolean is acceptable.

element_required_property.reason: The report's required property is that _createCampaign should enforce startTimestamp in the future and startTimestamp + duration in the future so funds are only pulled for runnable campaigns. The plan encodes only 'campaign_creation_rejected' plus absence of the pull, dropping the explicit enforcement of both time conditions and the protective purpose (funds only pulled for campaigns that can produce a Merkle root).

element_bad_outcome.reason: The plan formalizes only i_funds_locked (funds idle/unrecoverable). The report's bad outcome also includes no Merkle root ever produced, fees charged, and full campaign amount loss; these are explicitly deferred, so the outcome is materially narrowed.

formula_preconditions.reason: The precondition conjunction matches the three report preconditions as grounded Booleans with correct polarity and checkpoints.

formula_required_property.reason: The relation obligation encodes rejection of backdated creation and absence of the pull, but omits the report's explicit dual time-enforcement requirement (startTimestamp >= block.timestamp and startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp) and the protective intent that funds only be pulled for campaigns that can run.

formula_bad_outcome.reason: Only the funds-locked impact is encoded; the no-Merkle-root, fee-charging, and full-amount-loss impacts from the report are deferred, narrowing the bad outcome.
